detail: In his HATVP declaration of assets, Macron reported no individual shares held directly. As in 2017, he declared no real estate, no movable goods worth €10,000 or more, and no motor vehicle, and no directly owned equities. There is no declared individual stock portfolio.

holding: Equity savings plan (PEA) at Crédit Mutuel
detail: A plan d'épargne en actions (PEA), a tax-advantaged French equity-savings wrapper that holds shares and/or funds. The declaration reports only the lump value, not individual line items or tickers.

holding: Equity savings plan (PEA) at Rothschild Martin Maurel
detail: A second, smaller PEA held at Rothschild Martin Maurel. Again, only the aggregate value is declared, with no breakdown of underlying securities.

holding: Securities accounts (comptes-titres) at Crédit Mutuel and Rothschild Martin Maurel
detail: Two small ordinary securities accounts (comptes-titres) of €1,958 and €1,897 held at the same two banks. Their contents are not itemised in the declaration.

The HATVP declaration groups his two PEAs and two securities accounts under 'instruments financiers', totalling €67,527 in 2022 (up modestly from €65,626 in his 2017 declaration). This is the entirety of his declared market-securities exposure outside life insurance.

A life-insurance contract worth €113,473 in 2022 (up from €91,954 in 2017). French assurance-vie can hold euro funds and/or unit-linked (market) supports, but the declaration does not break down the allocation, so the equity portion (if any) is not disclosed.

holding: Direct stakes in companies (parts sociales / participations)
detail: Macron's declaration lists no direct ownership stakes in any company. No SCI, business participation, or unlisted-company shareholding is reported.

value: Not disclosed as a portfolio; earnings reported at approx. €2.9 million (media estimate)
detail: Macron earned a reported (Financial Times) ~€2.9 million as a Rothschild banker. There is no public record of a standing equity portfolio from that period; reporting indicates much was spent or taxed, and his later declarations show only modest financial-instrument balances. Treat the earnings figure as a media estimate, not a declared holding.
